description.en: Browser automation framework for AI Agents: 7 MCP tools (observe/act/diagnose/eval/screenshot/session_log/close), integrating Browser-Use, Stagehand, Chrome DevTools, Playwright. Stealth anti-detection, real-time visualization panel, 6-star scripting engine.
description.zh: AI Agent 浏览器自动化控制框架：7 个 MCP 工具（observe/act/diagnose/eval/screenshot/session_log/close），融合 Browser-Use、Stagehand、Chrome DevTools、Playwright 四大引擎。隐身反检测、实时可视化面板、6 星脚本化引擎。
